# Game Idea: Skyline Runner

A simple endless side‑scroll on an HTML canvas where the player controls a tiny ship that can ascend or descend with clicks/taps to avoid silhouette buildings. The game ends when the ship collides with a building or falls below the ground. Score is the distance traveled.

1: // Simple endless runner with enhanced graphics
2: // Ship ascends on click/tap, avoids scrolling buildings.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // Audio context for sound effects
8:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
9:   const playTone = (freq, duration) => {
10:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
11:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
12:     osc.type = 'square';
13:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
14:     osc.connect(gain);
15:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
16:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
17:     osc.start();
18:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
19:   };
20: 
21:   // Resize canvas to fill its container
22:   const stars = [];
23:   const clouds = [];
24:   const generateStars = () => {
25:     const count = Math.floor(canvas.width * canvas.height * 0.0001);
26:     stars.length = 0;
27:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
28:       stars.push({ x: Math.random() * canvas.width, y: Math.random() * canvas.height * 0.6, r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5 });
29:     }
30:   };
31:   // Generate simple clouds for background
32:   const generateClouds = () => {
33:     const count = Math.floor(canvas.width * 0.02);
34:     clouds.length = 0;
35:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
36:       const w = 60 + Math.random() * 40;
37:       const h = 30 + Math.random() * 20;
38:       clouds.push({ x: Math.random() * canvas.width, y: Math.random() * canvas.height * 0.4, w, h, speed: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5 });
39:     }
40:   };
41:     const resize = () => {
42:       canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
43:       canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
44:       generateStars();
45:       generateClouds();
46:     };
47:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
48:   // Generate stars and clouds initially and on resize
49:   generateStars();
50:   generateClouds();
51:   resize();
52: 
53:   const ship = {
54:     x: 50,
55:     y: 0,
56:     w: 20,
57:     h: 15,
58:     vy: 0,
59:     color: '#ff0',
60:   };
61: 
62:   const gravity = 0.4;
63:   const thrust = -8; // upward velocity on input
64: 
65:   let buildings = [];
66:   const buildingSpeed = 2;
67:   const buildingGap = 150; // distance between buildings
68:   const minHeight = 40;
69:   const maxHeight = 200;
70: 
71:   let frame = 0;
72:   let score = 0;
73:   let running = true;
74: 
75:   let thrusting = false;
76:   const inputHandler = () => {
77:     if (running) {
78:       ship.vy = thrust;
79:       thrusting = true;
80:       // Play thrust sound
81:       playTone(400, 0.08);
82:     }
83:   };
84:   canvas.addEventListener('click', inputHandler);
85:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', inputHandler);
86: 
87:   const addBuilding = () => {
88:     const height = minHeight + Math.random() * (maxHeight - minHeight);
89:     const x = canvas.width + (buildings.length ? buildingGap : 0);
90:     buildings.push({ x, w: 40, h: height });
91:   };
92: 
93:   const update = () => {
94:     if (!running) return;
95:     frame++;
96:     // Ship physics
97:     ship.vy += gravity;
98:     ship.y += ship.vy;
99:     // Keep ship within top bound
100:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y = 0, ship.vy = 0;
101:     // Ground check (bottom of canvas)
102:     if (ship.y + ship.h > canvas.height) {
103:       running = false;
104:       playTone(150, 0.3);
105:     }
106:     // Buildings movement
107:     buildings.forEach(b => b.x -= buildingSpeed);
108:     // Clouds movement (parallax)
109:     clouds.forEach(c => {
110:       c.x -= c.speed;
111:       if (c.x + c.w < 0) {
112:         c.x = canvas.width + Math.random() * 100;
113:         c.y = Math.random() * canvas.height * 0.4;
114:       }
115:     });
116:     // Remove off‑screen buildings
117:     if (buildings.length && buildings[0].x + buildings[0].w < 0) buildings.shift();
118:     // Add new building as needed
119:     if (!buildings.length || buildings[buildings.length - 1].x < canvas.width - buildingGap) {
120:       addBuilding();
121:     }
122:     // Collision detection
123:     for (const b of buildings) {
124:       const shipRect = { x: ship.x, y: ship.y, w: ship.w, h: ship.h };
125:       const buildingRect = { x: b.x, y: canvas.height - b.h, w: b.w, h: b.h };
126: if (rectIntersect(shipRect, buildingRect)) {
127:             running = false;
128:             playTone(200, 0.2);
129:             break;
130:           }
131:     }
132:     // Score based on distance
133:     score = Math.floor(frame * buildingSpeed / 10);
134:   };
135: 
136:   const rectIntersect = (a, b) => {
137:     return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
138:   };
139: 
140:   const draw = () => {
141:     // Sky gradient
142:     const skyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
143:     skyGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001d3a');
144:     skyGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0a2a5a');
145:     ctx.fillStyle = skyGrad;
146:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
147:     // Draw stars
148:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
149:     for (const s of stars) {
150:       ctx.beginPath();
151:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
152:       ctx.fill();
153:     }
154:     // Draw clouds (simple rounded rectangles with gradient)
155:     for (const c of clouds) {
156:       const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(c.x, c.y, c.x, c.y + c.h);
157:       gradient.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)');
158:       gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)');
159:       ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
160:       ctx.beginPath();
161:       ctx.ellipse(c.x + c.w/2, c.y + c.h/2, c.w/2, c.h/2, 0, 0, Math.PI*2);
162:       ctx.fill();
163:     }
164:     // Clear ground area before drawing other elements
165:     // (ground will be drawn later over sky)
166:     // ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height); // removed
167:     // Draw ground
168:     ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
169:     ctx.fillRect(0, canvas.height - 20, canvas.width, 20);
170:     // Draw ship (simple triangle with thrust flame)
171:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.color;
172:     ctx.beginPath();
173:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y);
174:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x - ship.w / 2, ship.y + ship.h);
175:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y + ship.h);
176:     ctx.closePath();
177:     ctx.fill();
178:     // Thrust flame
179:     if (thrusting && running) {
180:       ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
181:       ctx.beginPath();
182:       ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
183:       ctx.lineTo(ship.x - ship.w / 4, ship.y + ship.h + 10);
184:       ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 4, ship.y + ship.h + 10);
185:       ctx.closePath();
186:       ctx.fill();
187:       thrusting = false; // reset after draw
188:     }
189:     // Draw buildings with gradient and window lights
190:     for (const b of buildings) {
191:       const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, canvas.height - b.h, 0, canvas.height);
192:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#333');
193:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#111');
194:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
195:       ctx.fillRect(b.x, canvas.height - b.h, b.w, b.h);
196:       // Window grid
197:       const rows = Math.floor(b.h / 20);
198:       const cols = Math.floor(b.w / 15);
199:       for (let r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
200:         for (let c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
201:           if (Math.random() < 0.1) { // lit window chance
202:             ctx.fillStyle = '#ffea00';
203:             const wx = b.x + c * 15 + 3;
204:             const wy = canvas.height - b.h + r * 20 + 3;
205:             ctx.fillRect(wx, wy, 8, 12);
206:           }
207:         }
208:       }
209:     }
210:     // Draw score
211:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
212:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
213:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}` , 10, 30);
214:     // Game over overlay
215:     if (!running) {
216:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
217:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
218:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
219:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
220:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
221:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
222:       ctx.font = '18px sans-serif';
223:       ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${score}` , canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 10);
224:     }
225:   };
226: 
227:   };
228: 
229:   const loop = () => {
230:     update();
231:     draw();
232:     if (running) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
233:   };
234:   // Start the game
235:   // Initialize first building to avoid empty start
236:   addBuilding();
237:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
238: })();
